## Styling

[MUI](https://mui.com) backs `src/components/{Button,Input,Modal,Spinner}.jsx` — `Button` wraps MUI's `Button`, `Input` wraps `TextField`, `Modal` wraps `Dialog`, `Spinner` wraps `CircularProgress`. Every other module (`auth-react`, `router-react`, `state-zustand`, ...) only ever imports from `./components/*`, so it works unchanged no matter which styling library is picked — this is the one place MUI is actually wired in.

A real `ThemeProvider` + `createTheme({ palette: { mode } })` lives in `src/theme/ThemeContext.jsx`, driven by the same light/dark/system `ThemeToggle` (styled with MUI's own `ToggleButtonGroup` + `@mui/icons-material`) every styling option ships. It deliberately skips `CssBaseline` — that would overwrite the gradient hero background from `index.css` with MUI's own flat background color.
